results.title: Bullion Records star Harcher drops ‘Angelina’ amid UK tour
results.description: Nigerian Afrobeats superstar and Bullion Records artiste, Abdul Rahman Yusuf, popularly known as Harcher, has released a new single, “Angelina,” as he continues to gain momentum with his ongoing United Kingdom tour.

results.title: Amanda Kloots reveals sign she received from late husband Nick Cordero before launch of her new podcast
results.description: The day before she launched her new podcast "Good Grief," Amanda Kloots spoke to her late husband, Broadway star Nick Cordero, who gave his blessing from above -- in the form of her favorite song.
